test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 28 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: D, E, F, G, L, M and N are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Only one person sits between F and G when counted from the right of F. Only one person sits between G and D when counted from right of G. Only one person sits between F and L when counted from left of F. Only two people sit between E and D when counted from left of D. Only one person sits between N and L when counted from right of N. Who sits to the immediate right and left of M, respectively?
solution:
Given: D, E, F, G, L, M and N are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) Only one person sits between F and G when counted from the right of F. 

2) Only one person sits between G and D when counted from right of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56872e6637f040a3c3eefb5ee74df63e0dc20d67c5db1364ecdd7ef0f4de307c.png] 

3) Only one person sits between F and L when counted from left of F. 

4) Only two people sit between E and D when counted from left of D. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/426113c9c61a44b62885b5aaecf5c268856d0266d91f4ea0f229c4750291a2dd.png] 

5) Only one person sits between N and L when counted from right of N. 

After positioning N only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60c085c6544163180f7bb4a856697573baf3e5884a4ed77912a253570d1b5da1.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, F and L sits to the immediate right and left of M, respectively.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
